encoders.name: ContentVec 768 · INT8 (MobiGPT per-channel)
encoders.notes: Recommended. MatMul-only dynamic INT8 with per-channel weights and 7-bit range, built by MobiGPT CI: 0.986 mean cosine vs FP32 features (upstream q8: 0.887). Falls back to the upstream INT8 file if the MobiGPT release is unreachable.

encoders.name: ContentVec 768 · INT8 (upstream q8)
encoders.notes: Smallest (95 MB) but measured 0.887 mean cosine vs FP32 in MobiGPT CI; prefer the MobiGPT per-channel build.

encoders.name: ContentVec 768 · FP32
encoders.notes: Reference precision. Best intelligibility; needs ~0.6 GB RAM while loaded.
